catalogue.name: Luxembourg National Data Catalogue
catalogue.description: The Luxembourg National Data Catalogue aims to provide a comprehensive overview of all data available in the public sector in Luxembourg

unauthorised_message: Please contact your administrator to gain access to this application.
technical_support_message: For technical support, contact us at https://service.desk.lnds.lu

DATASET_COMPLETED.subject: Dataset Completed: $dataset_title
DATASET_COMPLETED.body:
Dear $recipient_name,

A dataset has been submitted and is ready for validation.

Dataset: $dataset_title
Link: $dataset_link

Please review and validate this dataset at your earliest convenience.

Thank you

DATASET_VALIDATED.subject: Dataset Ready for Approval: $dataset_title
DATASET_VALIDATED.body:
Dear $recipient_name,

A dataset has been validated and is ready for your approval.

Dataset: $dataset_title
Link: $dataset_link

Please review and approve this dataset at your earliest convenience.

Thank you

DATASET_DEPRECATED_WITH_NEW_VERSION.subject: Dataset Deprecated: $dataset_title
DATASET_DEPRECATED_WITH_NEW_VERSION.body:
Dear $recipient_name,

Thank you

ROLE_ASSIGNED.subject: Role Assignment Notification: $role_name for $target_user_name
ROLE_ASSIGNED.body:
Dear $recipient_name,

A role has been assigned in the system.

User: $target_user_name ($target_user_email)
Role: $role_name
Organisation: $organisation_name
Assigned by: $assigner_name

You can visit the application at: $app_url

Thank you

AUTHENTIC_SOURCE_ASSIGNMENT_CHANGED.subject: Authentic Source Assignment Changed: $dataset_title
AUTHENTIC_SOURCE_ASSIGNMENT_CHANGED.body:

Dataset: $dataset_title
Link: $dataset_link

Changes made:
$changes_summary

Modified by: $assigner_name

Thank you

KEYWORD_PROMOTED_TO_GLOBAL.subject: Keyword Promoted to Global: $keyword_name
KEYWORD_PROMOTED_TO_GLOBAL.body:
Dear $recipient_name,

The keyword "$keyword_name" from your organisation has been promoted to global status by $promoter_name.

Thank you
